subjects.description: A pedestrian carrying a large flat mirror almost as tall as themselves; the mirror faces the ego vehicle and reflects the road and sky, partly concealing the person's torso and legs
subjects.appearance_details: The mirror is a rectangular full-length wall mirror with a thin metallic silver frame, its reflective surface showing a distorted mirrored view of the residential street, parked cars, and pale blue sky. The person's forearms and hands grip the sides of the frame; a portion of the person's lower legs and shoes is visible beneath the mirror's bottom edge
subjects.relationship: Obstacle directly in the ego vehicle's path; the main subject the ego vehicle must detect and stop for
subjects.location: center foreground, slightly right of center, crossing the ego lane
subjects.orientation: Facing the camera as the mirror is held up toward the ego vehicle, body oriented perpendicular while walking across the lane
subjects.pose: Standing and walking laterally, arms raised and extended to grip both sides of the tall mirror, upper body hidden behind the reflective surface
subjects.action: Walking across the ego lane while carrying the large mirror
subjects.state_changes: Continues walking across the lane, gradually moving from center toward the left as the ego vehicle brakes; remains crossing throughout
subjects.clothing: Dark jeans and casual sneakers visible below the mirror's lower edge; upper clothing obscured by the mirror
subjects.skin_tone_and_texture: Partly visible lower legs; skin not clearly discernible due to mirror occlusion

background_setting: A quiet suburban residential street on a clear day. Single-family houses with pitched roofs, tidy front lawns, hedges, and driveways line both sides of the road. Parked cars sit along the curb, and mature trees cast dappled shadows onto the asphalt. Utility poles and overhead wires span the scene. The road surface is dry two-lane asphalt with faded lane markings and a central line.

lighting.direction: Sunlight from the upper right, casting consistent directional shadows
lighting.shadows: Sharp, consistent shadows of trees, poles, parked cars, and the pedestrian falling toward the lower left across the road
lighting.illumination_effect: Even, high-contrast daytime illumination with bright highlights on the mirror surface and crisp definition of street elements

aesthetics.composition: Centered dashcam-style composition with the road converging toward a vanishing point ahead; the mirror-carrying pedestrian occupies the central foreground, drawing the eye directly to the hazard
aesthetics.color_scheme: Natural palette of gray asphalt, green foliage, pale blue sky, warm house facades, with a bright silvery reflective mirror as a focal highlight
aesthetics.mood_atmosphere: Calm suburban routine turning cautious; alertness, safe automation
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating rhythm of parked cars, utility poles, and lane markings along the street

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward-moving dashcam perspective at a moderate speed that brakes smoothly and continuously over two full seconds to a complete stop at 0:03.5, then holds completely static and locked off with no movement of any kind
cinematography.framing: Wide shot from the driver's perspective
cinematography.focus: Sharp focus on the pedestrian, the mirror, and the road ahead

context: Autonomous vehicle perception and emergency-braking demonstration for a pedestrian carrying an occluding reflective object

actions.description: The ego vehicle drives forward along the residential street and detects the pedestrian carrying a large mirror crossing the ego lane ahead
The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.

The ego vehicle comes to a complete stop well before the pedestrian and remains stationary while the person continues crossing; the vehicle is parked and perfectly stationary and the camera does not move at all.

segments.description: Forward motion along the clear residential street; the pedestrian carrying the tall mirror is visible crossing the ego lane, the mirror facing the vehicle and reflecting road and sky
segments.key_changes: Distance to the pedestrian decreases as the vehicle approaches; detection of the hazard
segments.camera: Forward-moving dashcam view at steady speed

segments.description: The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.

segments.camera: Forward dashcam motion decelerating smoothly and continuously, coming to a complete rest at 0:03.5

segments.description: The ego vehicle is fully stopped and stationary, maintaining a safe distance before the pedestrian who continues walking across the lane with the mirror. The camera does not translate at all: the framing is identical from 0:03.5 to 0:05, like a photograph; nothing in the scene moves.

segments.camera: Locked-off stationary camera, zero translation, zero vibration, as if mounted on a tripod in a parked car

temporal_caption: At 0:00, the ego vehicle drives forward along the residential street and detects the pedestrian carrying a large mirror crossing the ego lane ahead. From 0:01.5 the vehicle brakes smoothly and continuously, its speed falling steadily. By 0:03.5 the vehicle has reached a complete standstill. From 0:03.5 to 0:05 the vehicle is parked and perfectly motionless: the camera does not translate at all and the framing is identical, like a still photograph.
audio_description: Ambient suburban daytime sound: a gentle breeze, distant birdsong, and the soft hum of the moving vehicle. As braking begins, a subtle rise in tire and brake friction is heard, followed by the quiet idle of the stationary car once stopped, with residual street ambience.
